findings.title: The bar on reading the builder's session record and git log inside the gating reviewer's scratch clone is a prompt instruction, not a technical control.
findings.evidence: GOV-017-multi-session-coordination-protocol.md:168-183 (the checkout bullet and the sentence naming the tension); the scratch clone contains docs/03-sessions/* and full git log.
findings.consequence: A gating reviewer with Bash/Grep could defeat the instruction; disclosed in the governed text and of the same trust-based kind as other controls in the protocol, so not blocking.

notes: Round 3. Dispatched and briefed by the Session Manager by hand. Brief: scope, acceptance and verification from dev's backlog.yaml, the range 8979a09..3b591a8 and the delta since 820821e (diffs given as file paths), the runner manifest (run from a coordinator-made scratch clone at 3b591a8; all 8 entries exit 0), that scratch clone as the gating reviewer's read-only checkout, the prior reviewer-written records, and the coordinator's fact that all four committed records match the ledger. No builder-written input. Raw reply kept at _working/session-manager/verdict-evidence/phase-asr-04/, as received with the harness's indentation removed. Round-2 F04: resolved per this reviewer. The reviewer self-reported running `git log --oneline 820821e..3b591a8` in the checkout and seeing two commit subject lines, contrary to its brief; it states it used none of that content as evidence.
